The files the focused agent named come first, newest first, with no title: the panel opened from that agent. A named file that also changed carries its stat there and is not listed again. Named files that did not change sit on one dim line by name, each name a link. Also changed holds only the rest. The named part exists only for an agent pane with a conversation (piece files.named, S; Hide stops the transcript read).
